candidates.statement: In [4, 5] we have outlined a program to systematically investigate the pattern of ﬂavor sym- metry breaking in three-ﬂavor lattice QCD for Wilson-type fermions.
candidates.formalization_note: Science claim (computational-simulation, evidence: both — In-paper result in sections/sec-000-1-introduction-and-general-strategy.md combined with [4, 5]). Empirical/numerical values are routed to compute-check for witness comparison, never wired as formal axioms.

candidates.statement: The region of no fusion is to the left, the region where all hydrogen is converted to helium stars is to the right. the n −p mass splitting in the ‘Dashen’ and MS schemes turns out to be somewhat larger (in absolute terms) than the numbers derived from the Cottingham formula [20].
candidates.formalization_note: Science claim (analytic-derivation, evidence: elsewhere — Cites external source [20] in sections/sec-002-3-results.md). Analytic theoretical derivation; candidate for model formalization.

candidates.statement: To accommodate the lower numbers from the Cottingham formula, the result of pure QCD [16] (fourth column of Table 1) would have to be smaller by a factor up to two as well.
candidates.evidence_locator: In-paper result in sections/sec-002-3-results.md combined with [16]
candidates.formalization_note: Science claim (analytic-derivation, evidence: both — In-paper result in sections/sec-002-3-results.md combined with [16]). Analytic theoretical derivation; candidate for model formalization.

candidates.statement: Conclusion and outlook We have outlined a program to systematically investigate the ﬂavor structure of hadrons in a full QCD + QED lattice simulation.
